verbatim_mask_macro:
#define UART_MASK_COMPUTATION(__HANDLE__)                             \
  do {                                                                \
    if ((__HANDLE__)->Init.WordLength == UART_WORDLENGTH_9B)          \
    {                                                                 \
      if ((__HANDLE__)->Init.Parity == UART_PARITY_NONE)              \
      {                                                               \
        (__HANDLE__)->Mask = 0x01FFU ;                                \
      }                                                               \
      else                                                            \
      {                                                               \
        (__HANDLE__)->Mask = 0x00FFU ;                                \
      }                                                               \
    }                                                                 \
    else if ((__HANDLE__)->Init.WordLength == UART_WORDLENGTH_8B)     \
    {                                                                 \
      if ((__HANDLE__)->Init.Parity == UART_PARITY_NONE)              \
      {                                                               \
        (__HANDLE__)->Mask = 0x00FFU ;                                \
      }                                                               \
      else                                                            \
      {                                                               \
        (__HANDLE__)->Mask = 0x007FU ;                                \
      }                                                               \
    }                                                                 \
    else if ((__HANDLE__)->Init.WordLength == UART_WORDLENGTH_7B)     \
    {                                                                 \
      if ((__HANDLE__)->Init.Parity == UART_PARITY_NONE)              \
      {                                                               \
        (__HANDLE__)->Mask = 0x007FU ;                                \
      }                                                               \
      else                                                            \
      {                                                               \
        (__HANDLE__)->Mask = 0x003FU ;                                \
      }                                                               \
    }                                                                 \
    else                                                              \
    {                                                                 \
      (__HANDLE__)->Mask = 0x0000U;                                   \
    }                                                                 \
  } while(0U)
limits: Selected full bodies and verbatim public mask macro; explicit ARM32 ABI/macros, not full SDK.
Original callback pointers are stored as ABI metadata; pointed ISR bodies are not executed by these start calls.
USART1 only in fixture; no LPUART compatibility inference.
